text.en: Most regular clients praise Linda and her team on Clay Road for their kind, friendly attitude and patient approach toward pets. However, a couple of dissatisfied reviewers mention encountering rude conduct, including eye-rolling and abrupt interactions when asking for haircut corrections.

title.en: Gentle approach for cats and seniors

text.en: Reviewers emphasize the salon's gentle treatment of animals, noting successful appointments for senior pets up to 18 years old and multiple specialty shampoo baths for cats. Several dog owners observe that their pets leave relaxed, playful, and completely unbothered.

title.en: Clean styling with occasional uneven trims

text.en: Many customers express satisfaction with neat breed styling, particularly for Pomeranians and poodles who come away clean and fresh. In contrast, several reviews report disappointing results, citing rushed scissor work, uneven lines on faces, and unbrushed coats upon collection.

a.en: Yes, reviewers mention bringing elderly pets, including an 18-year-old toy poodle, for careful grooming.

q.en: Are cats accepted for bath and coat services?

a.en: Yes, clients note that cats receive gentle grooming baths using specialty shampoo products.

q.en: Does the salon also offer boarding?

a.en: Yes, the facility provides both pet grooming and dog boarding services on Clay Road.
